defs.def: near the beginning of a period of time, an event etc. 早期的；初期的；早先的

ex.s: In an earlier era, the Disruptor would have been called an Innovator.

ex.s: He was facing health issues and his wife of thirty-five years had passed away a few months earlier.

ex.s: The good news is that I can help my own kids learn earlier than I did how to live more with less.
ex.t: 好消息是，我能帮助自己的孩子比我更早学会如何用更少的东西生活得更好。

ex.s: Inhabitants of Boise, Idaho, watched with trepidation earlier this year as the city's oldest, tallest resident moved two blocks.
ex.t: 这家总部位于德克萨斯的公司开发并获得专利了一种挖掘和搬运技术来移动巨大的树木。

ex.s: They often get up earlier and water the vegetables together.

ex.t: 我真的很早就醒了，踮着脚走到厨房。

ex.s: Even if this method of timekeeping is novel in its particulars，early agricultural societies also connected time to natural phenomena．In pre-Classical Greece，for instance，people“corrected”official calendars by shifting dates forward or backward to reflect the change of season．Temporal connection to the environment was vital to their survival．Likewise，river time and other timekeeping systems we're developing may encourage environmental awareness．
ex.t: 即便这种计时方式在细节上很新颖，早期的农业社会也将时间与自然现象联系起来。例如在前古典时期的希腊，人们会通过把日期向前或向后调整来“修正”官方历法，以反映季节的变化。与环境的时间联系对他们的生存至关重要。同样，我们正在开发的河流时间和其他计时系统或许也能唤起人们的环保意识。

ex.s: The Bitter Truth about Early Humans
ex.t: 早期人类的苦涩真相

ex.t: A 为了提供早期预警。

ex.s: Ways to Teach Kids Work Ethic Early

ex.s: My roommates would tell me to go to bed and get up early the following morning to do it instead.

ex.s: Get up early to do my homework?

ex.s: Most famously, a Canadian journalist who had moved her family to Manhattan in the early 1950s led a campaign to stop the destruction of her local park.
ex.t: 最著名的是，一位加拿大记者在1950年代初将她的家人迁至曼哈顿，他领导了一场停止她当地公园被毁的运动。

ex.s: Studies show teaching children how to cook at an early age helps with reading comprehension and fine motor ability, in addition to learning about nutrition and food safety.

ex.s: By the early 1970s, after centuries of cruel and continuous hunting by settlers, 600 to 800 grizzlies remained on a mere 2 percent of their former range in the Northern Rockies.
ex.t: 到20世纪70年代初，在定居者几个世纪残酷而持续的捕猎之后，在北部落基山脉，仅剩600到800只灰熊栖息在它们昔日活动范围的区区2%的土地上。

ex.s: In my early thirties, I decided to climb Mount Kilimanjaro, the highest mountain in Africa at 5, 895 meters above sea level.
ex.t: 30年代初，我决定登上乞力马扎罗山，这是非洲最高的山峰，海拔5,895米。

ex.s: Ms Young developed a passion for cooking at an early age.
ex.t: Young 女士早年培养了对烹饪的热情。

ex.s: Since early 2020, Ms Young has raised money to buy meals from Chinatown restaurants and deliver them to those in need.
ex.t: 自2020年初以来，杨女士一直在筹款购买唐人街餐厅的餐食并送给需要帮助的人。

ex.s: In most people the first signs show up in their 50s or early 60s.
ex.t: 对于大多数人来说，最初的症状出现在50多岁或60岁出头。

ex.s: Andrew Reynolds, a cheerful fellow in his early 30s, pilots Sydney ferryboats for a living.

ex.t: 第二天清晨我很早就醒了，22 着前方不确定的日子。

ex.s: The adorable female calf is the second black rhino born this year at the reserve, but it is too early to tell if the calves will make good candidates to be returned to protected areas of the wild.
ex.t: 这只可爱的雌性幼崽是今年该保护区出生的第二头黑犀牛，但现在判断这些幼崽是否适合被放归野外保护区还为时过早。

ex.t: 摇滚音乐发展于20世纪50年代和60年代早期。

ex.t: 尽管她早年就创办了公司，但她主要的驱动力并非利润。

defs.def: near the beginning of a period of time, an event, a piece of work, etc. 在早期；在初期；在开始阶段

ex.s: Which of the following starts earliest?
ex.t: 以下哪项开始得最早？

ex.s: My wife and I wanted to share our new home with family and friends by hosting a small gathering in the early summer.
ex.t: 我和妻子想在初夏举办一个小聚会，与亲友分享我们的新家。

ex.s: Parry quickly graduated from his early hearts and sharks, and started to surprise families with drawings that captured young patients’ personalities.
ex.t: 帕里很快不再画最初的心形和鲨鱼，而是开始用捕捉小患者个性的画作给各个家庭带来惊喜。

ex.s: It began earlier than proper thought.
ex.t: 它比人们认为的开始得更早。

ex.s: Yet properly understood, the age of electricity is merely the second stage in the age of steam, which began a century earlier.
ex.t: 然而正确理解的话，电力时代仅仅是蒸汽时代的第二阶段，蒸汽时代开始于一个世纪前。

ex.s: One night, in my early 40s, I dreamed that a big woman in red approached me, handed me a bag of paints, and told me to start painting.
